business_summary: Minerva Group Holding Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the financial services business in Hong Kong. The company operates through three segments: Financial Services, Money Lending, and Assets Investment. The Financial Services segment offers securities brokerage, placing, and corporate finance advisory services. The Money Lending segment provides loan financing services; vessels; and guarantees. The Asset Investment segment invests in debt securities earning fixed interest income, investments in properties earning rental income and capital gains, as well as investments in listed and unlisted equity securities and investment funds earning variable returns and gains. The company was formerly known as Power Financial Group Limited and changed its name to Minerva Group Holding Limited in July 2023. Minerva Group Holding Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Hong Kong, Hong Kong.
